name: Tak (Thailand)
description: Seven alternating horizontal stripes of purple and yellow, with a blue triangle extending from the hoist bearing the provincial seal of Tak.
history: Used as the official flag of Tak province by the provincial government (changwat). Most Thai provincial flags follow a common formula: the provincial seal (the same seal used on the provincial coat of arms) charged on a single-colour field. The designs are traditional and date back to the formation of modern provincial administration in Thailand.
